text:
Cloud cost is running 21.8% above its baseline (medium severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is matching-service (root-cause confidence 88%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along matching-service -> redis, matching-service -> maps-api. The next candidate, maps-api (43%), was ruled out: its load rose x2.57, but that load is pushed by its callers; its own behaviour did not change. Estimated impact traced to matching-service: $2,900/month.

Supporting evidence:
- Calls/request to maps-api rose x4.00 (1.50 → 6.01)
- Calls/request to redis rose x2.00 (4.00 → 8.00)
- Deployed v3.0 2h before its own behaviour changed
- Accounts for 94% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to redis rose x2.24
- Total calls to maps-api rose x4.48
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.98)

Recommended: Fix matching-service call amplification to maps-api. Estimated saving $2,584/month, latency -22.5%, error rate +0.0pp, risk low. Not recommended: Reduce database capacity 25%, because latency +19% > +10% limit.
